description: OMNIBUS is an ontology-based framework developed by Mizoguchi and colleagues for representing instructional theories as alternative decompositions of learning goals into sequenced sub-goals for instructional-system and scenario design.
title: OMNIBUS ontology of learning/instructional theories

description: The OmniEdu corpus is a curated, audited, diverse instruction-tuning dataset for education-focused language models, created by Hao Liang et al.
title: OmniEdu capability-oriented instruction-tuning corpus
